output.summary: KEP-3325 proposed a new authentication.k8s.io endpoint (SelfSubjectReview, later renamed SelfSubjectAttributesReview) that returns the attributes the current user has after authentication, plus a `kubectl auth whoami` command. The KEP reached implemented and stable status.
output.rationale:
Authentication via proxy, webhook, and other authenticators makes it unclear which user attributes apply after authentication, which hinders debugging. The proposal adds a self-review endpoint, since the user hits it after authentication, so all attributes are available to return. Reviewers pushed for a kubectl front end, a POST create verb, reuse of the UserInfo struct, and a way to disable the API via runtime-config.</rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">null

alternatives.option: Delegate requests to an external API server (e.g., Pinniped's whoami API)
alternatives.why_not: The readme says it is complicated to maintain an additional API server and that it integrates poorly with tooling such as client-go and kubectl.

alternatives.option: Use a GET to a user resource such as /apis/user.openshift.io/v1/users/~
alternatives.why_not: Reviewer deads2k asked for an exact URL and HTTP method; the thread moved to a create verb on a review object, with enj asking for a POST to a selfuserattributesreview resource, which matches other create-verb APIs.

alternatives.option: Deny the API via a validating admission webhook instead of a dedicated flag
alternatives.why_not: enj suggested this as a more practical way to deny it, and the thread notes runtime-config can disable a single resource once the API is GA; the sources do not record a final choice between them beyond the runtime-config note.

evidence.quote: Add the API endpoint to get user attributes - Add a corresponding kubectl command - `kubectl auth whoami`
The user will hit the endpoint after authentication happens, so all attributes will be available to return.
I would expect to see a `kubectl auth whoami` command that internally calls any available version of this API that it understands
I will mention that the note about disabling only becomes relevant once the selfsubjectattributesreview API reaches GA.
Closing this issue as complete now that the feature is GA.
